name: walk-back
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT BACK view faces directly AWAY, only back of head/back tunic/rear shoes visible. NO face/eyes/chest. Exactly TWO COMPLETE full-body WALK poses in TWO equal cells left then right on horizontal1536x1024 sheet. Frame1 OPEN STEP: one leg away and opposite shoe lifted behind toward camera, one sole visible. Frame2 PASSING STEP: BOTH SHOES DIRECTLY UNDER HIPS, legs close together, one heel lifted and knee bent, opposite slack arm swing. Frame2 narrow stance MUST differ strongly from frame1 open stride. Do NOT repeat extended-leg pose. Same head/body/clothing scale and local ground row, full figures around760px high, generous transparent margins and complete shoes/fingers.
